title: ModRisk-MultiNet: frequency-audited MVMR and corrected multimorbidity network outputs
description: Versioned project-authored code and derived, non-restricted outputs for a 71-disease multimorbidity genetic-correlation network. Version 1.0.2 excludes 17 frequency-ambiguous palindromic variants from the strict-primary MVMR analysis, retains 406 variants (405 for four outcomes), regenerates IVW and robust sensitivity analyses, and documents the corrected baseline-by-residual significance cross-tabulation. Manuscripts and restricted third-party GWAS files are not redistributed.
